{
  "score": 8,
  "findings": [
    {
      "file": "core/pipeline/runner.sh",
      "category": "hot-path subprocess",
      "severity": "low",
      "line": 3936,
      "message": "`resume_mode` is never cleared after the interrupted stage is dispatched, so `get_state_field` (spawning a subshell + `validate_json` jq call + a second jq field read = 3 processes) fires for every remaining dispatch unit in the loop, even though none of those post-interruption stages can be `complete`.",
      "quote": "_du_stage_status=\"$(get_state_field \"$state_file\" \\\n                            \".stage_statuses[\\\"$_safe_ust\\\"]\" '' 2>/dev/null || true)\"",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    },
    {
      "file": "core/pipeline/runner.sh",
      "category": "repeated subprocess in startup loop",
      "severity": "low",
      "line": 1773,
      "message": "In `_runner_from_stage_preflight`, `_find_plugin_for_stage` is called inside `$()` for each stage before `<s>`; because each call is in a subshell, the in-shell plugin-discovery memo populated by `discover_plugins_into` is discarded after every call, so each iteration re-runs `_discovery_tree_shape_v` (one `find -maxdepth 3` over the plugins tree, ~20 ms per the discovery.sh comment) even though the tree is static throughout the preflight.",
      "quote": "_fsp_plugin_dir=\"$(_find_plugin_for_stage \"$_fsp_s\" \"$_fsp_plugins_root\" 2>/dev/null || true)\"",
      "introduced": true,
      "fix": "code"
    }
  ]
}
